definitions.full: H1517. gid גִּיד noun masculine Gen 32:33 sinew (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic גִּידָא , ; compare Arabic neck ) — construct גִּיד Genesis 32:33 (twice in verse); Isa 48:4 ; plural גִּידִים Job 10:11 ; Ezek 37:6 , גִּדִים 37:8 ; construct גִּידֵי Job 40:17 ; — sinew , in General of human body, || עצמות עור, בשׂר, , 10:11 compare Ezek 37:6 , 8 of thigh Genesis 32:33 (of beast) 32:33; iron sinew, figurative of obstinacy, Isa 48:4 ׳וג נְחוּשָׁה וּמִצְחֲךָ עָרְמֶּ֑ךָ בַּרְזֶל ; of hippopotamus, ׳ג פחדו , i.e. of his loins, Job 40:17 .

occurrences.englishText: You have clothed me with skin and flesh,
He moves his tail like a cedar.
Because I knew that you are obstinate,
I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.” ’ ”
I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
